newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka troops start new attack on Tamil rebels.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka troops start new attack on Tamil rebels.

text.p: Sri Lankan troops, backed by tanks, artillery and air support, launched a fresh attack on the heartland of Tamil Tiger rebel territory on northern mainland on Sunday, military officials said.
"There was fair amount of resistance from the LTTE," a military officer said, referring to the separatist Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE).
It was the first major push for more than a month by the Sri Lankan security forces, which had dug in north of the rebel-held northern town of Kilinochchi.
"Eleven soldiers have been killed in the operation," the officer said, asking not to be identified. "The LTTE must have suffered heavy casualties because of air and artillery strikes."
An LTTE radio broadcast confirmed heavy shelling by the military but gave no details.
The rebels have fought the predominantly Sinhalese Sri Lankan military for more than 13 years seeking an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the north and east of the island.
